notes: Mixed news: efficacy endpoint met, safety signal found. Sentiment is debatable; neutral is the reference, positive or negative are both arguable.

expected.title: RX-118 phase 2 interim analysis
expected.summary: In a phase 2 trial of 212 adults with chronic migraine, RX-118 met its primary endpoint, cutting monthly migraine days by 3.9 versus 1.6 on placebo. Elevated liver enzymes occurred in 11% of treated patients versus 2% on placebo. The trial continues with added liver monitoring and the phase 3 decision is delayed to the fourth quarter.
key_points: Monthly migraine days reduced by 3.9 versus 1.6 on placebo; primary endpoint met
Elevated liver enzymes in 11% on drug versus 2% on placebo
Monitoring board: continue with added liver monitoring
Phase 3 decision delayed until full data in the fourth quarter
